verdict.rationale: Daytona docs mention two sandbox types — container sandboxes (filesystem-only 'cold' snapshots) and VM sandboxes with a 'dedicated Linux VM or Windows operating system' — implying VM-based isolation is available as an option, plus a per-sandbox network firewall restricting outbound access. However there is no explicit documentation naming a specific hard-isolation technology (e.g., microVM/Firecracker/gVisor) or a security architecture whitepaper describing the isolation boundary guarantees for platform engineers. Missing for 10: explicit microVM/kernel-isolation technology documentation, a dedicated security architecture page, and independent/third-party verification of isolation claims.
